node.title: Re^8: getting rid of UTF-8
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Thanks for providing sample code, unfortunately I can't reproduce the issue, not on Windows or Linux. A common reason is that there is a mixup between the code and data you've posted here and the code and data you're actually using on your machine (Update: in this case, if the AM's [id://11148392|guess] is correct, then the issue is that you didn't post the full input data and script output). Make sure to re-read my nodes [id://11118322|here] and [id://1233709|here] on how to provide the most transparent data for us, and prodvide us with a full set of information to reproduce the issue, like the following.
